title: Refund Order between a Resident Funds Transfer and Other Coinsurance Payments
content:
Where a Medicare coinsurance charge was overpaid and was paid partly by a transfer from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account and partly by other payments recorded on the resident's episode under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage, the excess is shared between the transfer and the charge's other payments in the refund order. The refund order fixes **the transfer's portion** of the excess.

| When the charge's other payments were made | Transfer's portion |
|---|---|
| a payment other than the transfer named the charge on a later date than the transfer | the other payments are refunded first; the transfer's portion is what remains of the excess after them, never below zero |
| another payment named the charge on the transfer's own date | the excess multiplied by the transfer's paid part, divided by the paid part plus the other payments |
| otherwise | the whole excess |

The first row that fits decides.

## Hypothetical illustration

Excess $651.00; the transfer's paid part $1302.00; another payment by check $651.00.

| Date of the check | Transfer's portion |
|---|---|
| after the transfer | $651.00 less $651.00: $0.00 |
| same day as the transfer | $651.00 times 1302.00 divided by 1953.00: $434.00 |
| before the transfer | $651.00 |
